title: The Big Kick
summary: 朋友小赛进球:主角和朋友 Lily、Ben 在公园踢小比赛,主角把球高高踢进得分,朋友欢呼。
text: {{name}} loves soccer. {{name}} plays with Lily and Ben. They play at the park every day. Today they have a little game. Lily runs fast with the ball. She kicks it to {{name}}. {{name}} runs and runs. A big boy stands in the way. {{name}} stops. Then {{name}} kicks the ball high. The ball goes up and up. It goes in! Goal! Lily and Ben laugh and jump. "Good kick!" says Ben. {{name}} is so happy. Soccer is fun with good friends.
